description: Use when testing a web application for Local and Remote File Inclusion on an authorized engagement. Covers path traversal probes, PHP wrapper abuse (php://filter, data://, expect://, zip://, phar://), log poisoning and /proc/self/environ tricks for code execution, null byte and filter bypass techniques, and remote file inclusion through allow_url_include. Use when page, file, template, language, or view parameters load local files or URLs and might be abusable.
